title: From Seed to Bread

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: Look out of the window: the wheat is turning gold! Soon it will be harvest.

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: Do you know how a little seed becomes a loaf of bread? Put these cards in order, and see.

steps.speaker: hannah
steps.prompt: Put the cards in order: from a seed to a loaf.
steps.hint: First the seed is sown, and it grows. What comes after?

feedback.out_of_order: Some cards came back. What happens after the wheat grows?
feedback.all_good: Sown, grown, ground and baked! Every loaf began as a tiny seed.

outro.speaker: hannah
outro.text: The farmer sows, the miller grinds, the baker bakes, and God gives the growth. Every loaf is a gift from many hands.

journal_line: I learned how a seed becomes a loaf of bread with Mrs. Hannah.
